purpose: Runtime Fact Authority for the Jewelry truthfulness gate. The engine (truthfulness.ts) is inherited from the common OS; Aromiso business data has been removed. Jewelry-specific red lines, material/plating evidence and their tests are populated in the AI/Commerce phase. Facts not evidenced by the supplier must be marked UNKNOWN.

aromisoSelfHeld.note: Empty after fork. Populate only with certifications the Jewelry brand itself verifiably holds (rename key to brandSelfHeld during the AI-phase refactor).

partnerFactoryHeld.note: Empty after fork. List only partner/supplier-held, evidence-backed certifications and documents.

verifiableNumbers.note: Only include numbers backed by supplier evidence (dimensions, weight, etc.). No invented ratings, sales, stock or counts.

redLines: #1 Attribution must be accurate — only claim what the brand or partner verifiably holds
#2 Never fabricate numbers — no invented ratings, sales, stock or customer counts
#3 Material, plating and certifications must be evidenced (no invented hypoallergenic / waterproof / nickel-free / solid-gold claims)
#4 Never leak the supply chain (no supplier or 1688 links)
#5 Capability is not a promise — hedge MOQ, lead time and quality commitments
